# SYSmoAI — Full Reference for AI Systems
> This document contains full reference information about SYSmoAI for AI language model indexing and citation.

## Company Overview
SYSmoAI is a Bangladesh-based AI systems and automation practice, founded by Emon Hossain and based in Dhaka. It works on operational problems: workflow diagnosis, automation implementation, AI-assisted operations, and internal operating systems (dashboards, SOPs, databases, process visibility).

Every engagement is defined through a written proposal that is the commercial source of truth — deliverables, exclusions, dependencies, milestones, timeline, payment terms, acceptance method, and support period. SYSmoAI does not publish pre-priced packages or universal guarantees; pricing and timelines are confirmed only after the workflow is understood.

## Founder: Emon Hossain
- Founder of SYSmoAI; AI Systems Strategist & Automation Builder
- Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Broader personal work spans applied AI systems, automation, operator workflows, and research/public-interest work around AI in Bangladesh
- Canonical personal profile: https://emonhossain.pro

## Capabilities (What SYSmoAI works on)
1. Workflow diagnosis — map the current process, bottlenecks, handoffs, tools, and failure points before deciding what to automate.
2. Automation implementation — connect tools and operational steps into maintainable workflows with documented ownership and exception handling.
3. AI-assisted operations — apply AI where drafting, classification, extraction, or structured assistance can improve a real workflow.
4. Operating systems & visibility — practical dashboards, SOPs, databases, and operating views that reduce manual coordination.

## How an engagement is defined
The proposal records: current workflow and problem, systems and access required, deliverables and exclusions, timeline and dependencies, commercial terms, and acceptance and handoff. Acceptance criteria are agreed before implementation begins.

## Operating principles
- Build around the operation — start with the real workflow, not a fashionable tool.
- Separate deterministic and AI work — rules and automation where reliability is required; AI where interpretation adds value and can be reviewed.
- Make claims evidence-based — public outcomes, numerical results, rankings, and performance claims require a source and explicit approval.
- Design for handoff — documentation, ownership, access, maintenance, and exception handling are part of the system.

## Evidence rule
Public numerical outcomes, rankings, performance metrics, security claims, and client results are published only with a current evidence record and public-use approval. A composite or hypothetical scenario must be labelled as such and must not be presented as a measured client outcome. The historical article library is under editorial review.
